name: Mildred's Temple Kitchen
address: 85 Hanna Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 3S3
description: A Liberty Village institution since 2004, Mildred's Temple Kitchen is famous for its weekend brunch with signature blueberry buttermilk pancakes. The industrial-chic space in a converted factory is always buzzing with locals. Dinner service showcases elevated Canadian comfort food with seasonal ingredients.
proTip: The Saturday brunch gets packed by 10:30am — arrive early or put your name in and grab a coffee at Balzac's while you wait.

name: NODO
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: NODO brings wood-fired Neapolitan pizza and house-made pasta to Liberty Village in a warm, modern trattoria setting. Their dough is fermented for 72 hours and baked in a custom-built Italian oven imported from Naples. The open kitchen and communal tables make it a great spot for casual dinners with friends.
proTip: Ask for the burrata appetizer — it's not always on the menu but they almost always have it, and it pairs perfectly with a glass of their Montepulciano.

name: Chiang Mai Thai Restaurant
address: 45 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3R2
description: Chiang Mai has been the neighbourhood go-to for authentic Thai food since long before Liberty Village was full of condos. The pad thai and green curry are consistently solid, and the lunch specials are among the best deals in the area. It's a no-frills spot where the food does all the talking.
proTip: The weekday lunch combo is the best value meal in Liberty Village — generous portions of curry, rice, spring roll, and soup for under $15.

name: Burger Drops
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 129, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Burger Drops serves smashed burgers that rival anything on the Toronto burger scene. The menu is tight and focused — a few burger options, loaded fries, and milkshakes — and they execute every item with precision. The double smash with house-made pickles and special sauce has developed a cult following in the neighbourhood.
proTip: Order the double smash with cheese and add their garlic aioli fries — it's the definitive Burger Drops experience.

name: Impact Kitchen
address: 109 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X4
description: Impact Kitchen is where Liberty Village's fitness crowd refuels with nutrient-dense bowls, grass-fed burgers, and cold-pressed juices. Every dish lists its macros, making it easy to stay on track without sacrificing flavour. The space doubles as a community hub with nutrition workshops and wellness events.
proTip: Their weekly meal prep packages are a lifesaver if you work from home — order by Wednesday for Monday delivery and save 15% over individual orders.

name: LOCAL Public Eatery
address: 55 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: LOCAL Public Eatery is the neighbourhood's go-to for watching sports over elevated pub food and a curated craft beer list. The patio is one of the biggest in Liberty Village and absolutely packed on warm summer evenings. Their brunch game is also strong, with a solid Caesar bar on weekends.
proTip: Their daily happy hour from 3-6pm has $7 appetizers and $2 off all draft beers — the best deal for after-work drinks in the neighbourhood.

name: School Restaurant
address: 70 Fraser Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 3E2
description: School occupies a beautifully restored 1890s schoolhouse and serves creative Canadian cuisine with global influences. The heritage brick, soaring ceilings, and original chalkboards create one of the most atmospheric dining rooms in the city. Their brunch is a Liberty Village classic, and the cocktail menu is inventive and well-executed.
proTip: Request a table in the upstairs loft for the most intimate experience — it overlooks the main dining room and feels like a private dining space.

name: OEB Breakfast Co.
address: 2 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: OEB Breakfast Co. brought its Calgary-born brunch cult to Liberty Village, and the neighbourhood hasn't looked back. They're known for their signature Holy Smoked Meat Benedict and handcrafted crepes, all made from scratch with premium ingredients. Expect weekend waits — this place is legitimately worth the lineup.
proTip: Use their online waitlist on weekends — you can add your name from home and show up when your table is almost ready instead of standing outside.

name: Brazen Head Irish Pub
address: 165 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Brazen Head has been the beating heart of Liberty Village pub culture for years, with a massive wraparound patio that's arguably the neighbourhood's best warm-weather hangout. Inside it's all dark wood and Guinness on tap, with a menu of reliable pub classics. Their trivia nights and live music evenings keep the regulars coming back.
proTip: Wednesday trivia night is the best free entertainment in the neighbourhood — get there by 7pm to claim a good table because teams start forming early.

name: Moxie's Grill & Bar
address: 171 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Moxie's Liberty Village location offers a polished casual dining experience with a crowd-pleasing menu that covers everything from steaks to sushi rolls. The space is sleek and modern, with a solid bar program and consistent service. It's a reliable pick when you're dining with a group that can't agree on a cuisine.
proTip: Their late-night menu kicks in after 9pm with half-price appetizers — great for a post-movie bite if you've been to the nearby cinema.

name: The Rec Room
address: 100 Lynn Williams St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P5
description: The Rec Room is a massive entertainment complex with arcade games, VR experiences, live music, and multiple bars under one roof. It's the go-to for group outings and birthday parties, with a surprisingly decent food menu that goes beyond typical bar fare. Weekend nights transform into a club-like atmosphere with DJs and events.
proTip: Load up your game card on a Tuesday when they run double-credit promotions — you'll get twice the arcade time for the same price.

name: Liberty Commons at Big Rock Brewery
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 143, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Liberty Commons is Big Rock Brewery's Toronto taproom, offering house-brewed craft beers in a sprawling industrial-chic space that celebrates Liberty Village's manufacturing heritage. The beer hall vibe is perfect for big groups, with communal tables and a rotating selection of seasonal brews. Their wood-fired pizzas and beer cheese pretzels are ideal companions to a flight.
proTip: Ask your server about the brewer's small-batch — they always have an experimental beer on tap that's not listed on the main menu.

name: Craft Beer Market
address: 1 Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 1A6
description: Craft Beer Market boasts over 100 taps of Canadian craft beer in one of the most impressive bar setups in the city. The massive two-level space in a converted warehouse features exposed brick and steel beams that feel quintessentially Liberty Village. The food menu is designed for sharing, and the staff genuinely knows their beer.
proTip: Grab a seat on the upper mezzanine during Leafs games — you get the atmosphere of a packed bar with more breathing room and a better view of the screens.

name: Pizza Libretto
address: 155 Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 1A7
description: Pizza Libretto serves VPN-certified Neapolitan pizza with a leopard-spotted crust that comes out of their 900-degree wood-burning oven in under 90 seconds. The Margherita is a masterclass in simplicity, and the rotating seasonal pizzas are always worth trying. The Liberty Village location has a cozy neighbourhood feel that the busier downtown spots lack.
proTip: The Nduja pizza isn't always on the regular menu but ask if they have it — the spicy spreadable salami with honey is an absolute flavour bomb.

name: Pai Northern Thai Kitchen
address: 171 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Pai is widely considered one of the best Thai restaurants in Toronto, and their Liberty Village outpost delivers the same calibre of northern Thai cooking that made the Duncan St. original famous. The Khao Soi is a must-order — rich, coconut-y, and deeply satisfying. Expect a wait at peak hours because word has long been out.
proTip: Order the Khao Soi with crispy egg noodles on the side — you can add them gradually to keep them crunchy throughout the meal.

name: Cibo Wine Bar
address: 100 Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 1A7
description: Cibo Wine Bar brings a touch of Italian elegance to Liberty Village with a menu of refined pasta dishes, thin-crust pizzas, and an outstanding wine list. The space is dark and moody in all the right ways, making it one of the best date-night spots in the area. Their happy hour is a neighbourhood staple.
proTip: Their Aperitivo hour from 4-6pm on weekdays offers half-price appetizers and $10 cocktails — it's essentially a discounted dinner if you order enough small plates.

name: Balzac's Coffee Roasters
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 130, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Balzac's Liberty Village location sits inside the heritage Liberty Market building and is the neighbourhood's unofficial living room. The Parisian-inspired decor, excellent espresso, and ample seating make it ideal for remote workers and casual meetups alike. Their house blend is roasted in small batches at their Niagara facility.
proTip: The back room near the windows is the quietest spot for getting work done — most people crowd the front, so you'll have space and natural light.

name: Louie Coffee Bar
address: 171 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Louie Coffee Bar is a compact, design-forward coffee spot that takes its espresso seriously. They pull shots using rotating single-origin beans and their lattes are consistently beautiful — both visually and in the cup. The vibe is more grab-and-go than linger, but there are a few window seats for a quick break.
proTip: Try whatever their current seasonal latte is — they change it monthly and it's always more interesting than the standard menu options.

name: Arvo Coffee
address: 17 Fraser Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1Y7
description: Arvo is a minimalist Australian-style coffee shop that nails the basics — flat whites, long blacks, and perfectly pulled espresso. The interior is clean and bright with concrete floors and a blonde-wood aesthetic that feels calm even when it's busy. They also serve simple but excellent pastries and toasties.
proTip: Order the flat white with oat milk — it's the drink the baristas make for themselves and it's perfectly balanced with their current espresso blend.

name: Dark Horse Espresso Bar
address: 215 Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 1A6
description: Dark Horse Espresso has been a Toronto indie coffee institution for over a decade, and the Liberty Village outpost is a neighbourhood anchor. Known for strong espresso, generous portions, and a no-nonsense attitude, it's the place where Liberty Village's creative freelancers set up camp. The space is unpretentious with plenty of power outlets.
proTip: Don't sleep on their cold brew in summer — they steep it for 24 hours and it's smooth enough to drink black, which is how the regulars order it.

name: Jimmy's Coffee
address: 107 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X4
description: Jimmy's Coffee is a beloved Toronto chainlet with a rustic, lived-in charm that makes every location feel like your neighbourhood spot. The Liberty Village shop draws a loyal morning crowd for their drip coffee and signature peanut butter cookie. They roast their own beans and keep things simple and honest.
proTip: Their peanut butter cookie is legitimately one of the best cookies in Toronto — get one before noon because they sell out on most days.

name: GoodLife Fitness Liberty Village
address: 47 Jefferson Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1Y3
description: GoodLife Fitness Liberty Village is one of the busiest locations in the chain, packed with the neighbourhood's young professional crowd. The facility is well-maintained with a full range of cardio equipment, free weights, and group fitness classes. The location's convenience — walkable from virtually every condo in the area — keeps membership demand high.
proTip: Avoid the 5:30-7:30pm rush when every bench and squat rack is taken — the 6am opening or the 8:30pm window are the sweet spots for actually getting a workout in.

name: F45 Training Liberty Village
address: 17 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: F45 Liberty Village delivers the signature 45-minute functional training workouts that have made the franchise a global phenomenon. Each day brings a different circuit — alternating between cardio and resistance — so the routine never gets stale. The coaches know members by name and the community vibe keeps people showing up at 6am.
proTip: The 6:15am classes have the most consistent crew and the best energy — you'll make gym friends faster in the early morning sessions.

name: Altea Active
address: 2 Western Battery Rd, Toronto, ON M6K 3S2
description: Altea Active is a premium fitness and wellness club that feels more like a boutique hotel than a gym. Spread over multiple levels, it offers a massive workout floor, swimming pool, hot yoga studio, spa services, and a healthy restaurant all under one roof. The membership price is steep but you genuinely get a luxury experience.
proTip: The rooftop pool area is almost empty during weekday mornings — you'll feel like you have a private resort in the middle of Liberty Village.

name: Orangetheory Fitness Liberty Village
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 117, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Orangetheory's Liberty Village studio brings their signature heart-rate-based interval training to the neighbourhood. The one-hour classes mix treadmill, rowing, and floor exercises with real-time heart rate tracking displayed on screens throughout the studio. It's data-driven fitness that appeals to the tech-savvy Liberty Village demographic.
proTip: Book classes through the app exactly 24 hours before the class starts — popular time slots fill instantly and the waitlist rarely moves.

name: Studio Lagree
address: 130 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X9
description: Studio Lagree uses the patented Megaformer machine to deliver a slow-burn, full-body workout that will have your muscles shaking within minutes. The method combines elements of Pilates, strength training, and cardio into a 40-minute session that's deceptively intense. The instructors are exceptional at providing modifications for all fitness levels.
proTip: Wear grippy socks — they're required and the studio sells them, but you'll save money by ordering a pair of Toesox online before your first class.

name: b.suite
address: 120 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X9
description: b.suite is a modern suite-based salon where independent stylists rent their own private spaces, giving clients a personalized and intimate experience. The concept means you get one-on-one attention without the chaos of a traditional salon floor. Quality varies by stylist, but the top ones have months-long wait lists for good reason.
hours: By appointment — hours vary by stylist
proTip: Check Instagram for the individual stylists' portfolios before booking — each one specializes in different techniques and the right match makes all the difference.

name: Baz & Banks Barber
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: Baz & Banks is a sharp, modern barbershop that elevates the neighbourhood haircut into a proper grooming experience. The barbers are skilled with fades, tapers, and classic cuts, and the shop has a clean, masculine aesthetic without trying too hard. They also offer hot towel shaves and beard grooming services.
proTip: Book with one barber and stick with them — they'll remember your cut preferences and you'll save time explaining every visit.

name: Tips & Toes Nail Spa
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 109, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Tips & Toes is a clean and friendly nail spa right in the heart of Liberty Village's retail strip. They offer a full range of manicure, pedicure, and gel services at reasonable prices. The turnaround is quick without feeling rushed, making it easy to fit in a visit during a lunch break.
proTip: Tuesday is the quietest day — you'll get in without a wait and the technicians can take their time instead of rushing between clients.

name: Liberty Village Animal Hospital
address: 55 Hanna Ave, Unit 109, Toronto, ON M6K 3S3
description: Liberty Village Animal Hospital is the neighbourhood's primary vet clinic, handling everything from routine check-ups and vaccinations to dental cleanings and minor surgeries. The vets are compassionate and thorough, and the clinic is modern and well-equipped. In a neighbourhood with possibly the highest dog-per-capita ratio in Toronto, they stay busy.
proTip: Book your annual check-up and vaccinations in January or February when the schedule is lighter — spring and summer appointments can be weeks out.

name: Liberty Pooch
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON M6K
description: Liberty Pooch offers professional dog walking and pet sitting services tailored specifically to Liberty Village's condo-dwelling pups. Their walkers do small group walks through the local parks and trails, with GPS tracking so you can see where your dog went. They also offer puppy visits and overnight care for travel.
proTip: Book a meet-and-greet walk before committing — they match your dog's temperament with the right walking group, and the fit matters for your pup's happiness.

name: Woof & Whiskers
address: 171 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Woof & Whiskers caters to Liberty Village's massive pet owner population with premium food brands, toys, treats, and accessories. The staff are genuinely knowledgeable about pet nutrition and happy to help you find the right food for your pet's specific needs. They also stock local and Canadian-made products whenever possible.
proTip: Ask about their auto-delivery program for food — they'll deliver to your condo lobby monthly, which beats hauling a 30-pound bag from the store.

name: Liberty Village Dental
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 101, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Liberty Village Dental offers comprehensive dental care in a modern, comfortable office right in the neighbourhood's main retail hub. They handle cleanings, fillings, crowns, Invisalign, and cosmetic procedures with a gentle approach that puts anxious patients at ease. Evening and Saturday appointments make it genuinely convenient for working professionals.
proTip: Book the first appointment of the day if you're anxious about the dentist — you'll go straight in without a wait, the staff are fresh, and there's no lingering dental-sound anxiety from sitting in the waiting room.

name: Edition Dental
address: 65 Jefferson Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1Y3
description: Edition Dental positions itself as a boutique dental practice with a focus on cosmetic and restorative work, including veneers, whitening, and smile makeovers. The office feels more like a spa than a dental clinic, with calming interiors and a concierge-style booking experience. They also handle all general dentistry needs.
proTip: If you're considering veneers, book a free consultation first — they use digital smile design to show you a preview of your results before you commit.

name: Liberty Village Physiotherapy & Rehab
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 302, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: Liberty Village Physiotherapy handles sports injuries, post-surgical rehab, and chronic pain management with a hands-on approach. The clinic is staffed by registered physiotherapists who take time to build personalized treatment plans rather than cycling through cookie-cutter exercises. They also offer acupuncture and shockwave therapy.
proTip: Book the early morning slots if you want the longer, more thorough sessions — the therapists aren't running behind schedule yet and you'll get their full attention.

name: Spaces Liberty Village
address: 171 East Liberty St, Suite 200, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Spaces Liberty Village is a premium flexible workspace from IWG that occupies a massive footprint above the East Liberty retail strip. The design is modern and airy with a mix of private offices, dedicated desks, and hot-desking options. The rooftop patio and in-house cafe elevate it beyond a typical coworking space.
proTip: Try a free day pass before committing to a membership — the atmosphere changes significantly between Monday-morning energy and Friday-afternoon ghost town.

name: The Fueling Station
address: 33 Fraser Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1Y7
description: The Fueling Station is a community-focused coworking space in a converted Liberty Village warehouse that caters to freelancers, startups, and small creative agencies. Unlike the corporate coworking chains, this space has genuine character — exposed brick, mismatched furniture, and a communal kitchen where people actually talk to each other. Events and networking sessions happen regularly.
proTip: Attend one of their monthly community dinners before you sign up — you'll get a real feel for the people and decide if the vibe matches your work style.

name: WeWork
address: 60 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X9
description: WeWork's Liberty Village location occupies a beautifully converted heritage building on Atlantic Ave, blending exposed brick character with WeWork's polished, Instagram-ready interiors. The space offers private offices, dedicated desks, and common areas with the chain's signature craft beer on tap. The location draws a mix of tech startups and remote workers from the surrounding condos.
proTip: The top floor common area is the least crowded and has the best natural light — most people default to the ground floor and miss the best workspace in the building.

name: FreshCo
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 100, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: FreshCo is Liberty Village's most convenient full-service grocery store, anchoring the East Liberty retail strip. The prices are noticeably lower than the nearby specialty shops, and the produce section is surprisingly good for a discount grocer. For a neighbourhood historically underserved by grocery options, this store is an essential resource.
proTip: Shop before 10am on weekdays to avoid the cramped aisles — this store serves the entire neighbourhood and it shows during peak hours.

name: Shoppers Drug Mart
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 105, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: The Liberty Village Shoppers Drug Mart is the neighbourhood's primary pharmacy, handling prescriptions, over-the-counter medications, and the usual array of cosmetics and household essentials. The pharmacy team is efficient and the location's extended hours are a lifesaver when you need something after the rest of the strip closes down.
proTip: Their Optimum points promotions on weekends often include 20x points events — time your bigger purchases for these days and the points add up fast.

name: King West Dry Cleaners
address: 100 Lynn Williams St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P5
description: King West Dry Cleaners is a reliable neighbourhood cleaner that handles suits, dress shirts, delicates, and household items with consistent quality. They offer same-day service if you drop off before 10am, and their alterations team is skilled with everything from hemming to more complex tailoring. Delivery to nearby condos is available.
proTip: Set up a weekly pickup and delivery schedule if you wear dress shirts to work — they offer a 15% discount on recurring orders.

name: Yoga Tree
address: 97 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: Yoga Tree's Liberty Village studio offers a wide range of classes from gentle restorative sessions to power vinyasa in a warm, welcoming environment. The studio spaces are clean and well-maintained with quality props provided. Their teacher lineup includes some of the most experienced instructors in the Toronto yoga community.
proTip: The Sunday evening restorative class is the most underrated class on the schedule — it's never crowded and it's the perfect reset before the work week.

name: Liberty Village Chiropractic
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 405, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: Liberty Village Chiropractic provides evidence-based chiropractic care focused on desk workers and athletes — the two dominant populations in the neighbourhood. Dr. treatments combine spinal adjustments with soft tissue work and corrective exercises. They direct bill to most insurance providers, removing the hassle of claim submissions.
proTip: Mention you work from home or at a desk — they'll include a free ergonomic workstation assessment with your first visit that alone is worth the appointment.

name: Myodetox Liberty Village
address: 1 East Liberty St, Unit 105, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: Myodetox offers a modern approach to massage therapy and manual treatment, combining registered massage therapy with movement assessment and corrective exercise. Their therapists focus on finding the root cause of pain rather than just treating symptoms. The clinic is sleek and professional, a far cry from the dimly-lit spa massage experience.
proTip: Book a 60-minute assessment for your first visit instead of a standard massage — they'll identify compensation patterns and make all future sessions more targeted.

name: Scotiabank
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 108, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: The Scotiabank Liberty Village branch is the most convenient full-service bank in the neighbourhood, handling personal banking, mortgages, and investment services. The ATM is accessible 24/7, which matters more than you'd think when the nearest alternative is a trek to King Street. Wait times can be long during lunch hour.
proTip: Skip the branch entirely for routine transactions — their app handles almost everything, and save in-person visits for mortgage or investment consultations.

name: Movati Athletic
address: 80 Lynn Williams St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P5
description: Movati Athletic is a mid-premium gym that bridges the gap between GoodLife and Altea Active, offering a pool, hot yoga studio, and extensive group fitness schedule alongside a well-equipped weight room. The facilities are clean and modern, and the membership sweet spot appeals to those who want more than a basic gym without the luxury price tag.
proTip: The saltwater pool is almost empty between 1-3pm on weekdays — lane swimmers will get uninterrupted laps during this window.

name: Liberty Village Optometry
address: 171 East Liberty St, Unit 120, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Liberty Village Optometry provides comprehensive eye exams, contact lens fittings, and a curated selection of designer frames. The optometrists use modern diagnostic equipment and take time to explain findings clearly. Their frame selection leans toward trendy and independent brands that you won't find at chain optical stores.
proTip: Bring your insurance card and they'll bill directly and tell you exactly what's covered before you choose frames — no surprises at the checkout.

name: The Dog House Grooming
address: 38 Hanna Ave, Unit 8, Toronto, ON M6K 1X3
description: The Dog House is a Liberty Village grooming salon that treats neighbourhood dogs like royalty. From basic baths to full breed-specific grooming, their team handles everything with patience and skill, even with nervous or fidgety pups. The shop is clean and uses premium, gentle products that won't irritate sensitive skin.
proTip: Book a nail trim as a standalone visit first if your dog is nervous — it lets them get comfortable with the groomers before the full grooming experience.

name: Liberty Village Family Health Team
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 200, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: The Liberty Village Family Health Team is a multidisciplinary clinic offering family medicine, mental health counseling, and dietitian services under one roof. They accept new patients periodically and provide the continuity of care that walk-in clinics can't match. Same-day urgent appointments are usually available for rostered patients.
proTip: Call on the first Monday of each month to ask about new patient intake — they open spots in batches and they fill within days.

name: Sweet Flour Bake Shop
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: Sweet Flour is a charming from-scratch bakery known for flaky butter tarts, seasonal pies, and beautifully decorated custom cakes. Everything is baked in small batches daily, and the quality is consistent enough that locals pre-order for holidays weeks in advance. Their butter tart alone justifies a visit.
proTip: Order your Thanksgiving and Christmas pies at least two weeks in advance — they cap their orders and sell out every single year without fail.

name: SpinCo
address: 1 East Liberty St, Unit 110, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: SpinCo brings high-energy indoor cycling to Liberty Village with 45-minute classes set to curated playlists in a dark, club-like studio. The bikes have performance metrics so you can track your output and compete on the leaderboard. The instructors bring serious energy and the post-class endorphin rush is real.
proTip: Bike 3 and Bike 17 have the smoothest resistance dials — regulars know this and book them first, so snag one early if you want the best ride.

name: Left Field Brewery
address: 36 Wagstaff Dr, Toronto, ON M6K 0B2
description: Left Field Brewery is a baseball-themed craft brewery tucked into the industrial south end of Liberty Village with a taproom that's become a neighbourhood favourite. Their Eephus oatmeal brown ale and Greenwood IPA are flagship staples, but the seasonal and small-batch releases keep things exciting. The patio fills up fast on summer weekends with locals and craft beer pilgrims alike.
proTip: Grab a seat on the patio early on Saturday and order a flight — the four-pour sampler lets you try their seasonals without committing to a full pint of something adventurous.

name: Tonic Blooms
address: 113 Atlantic Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X4
description: Tonic Blooms is a boutique florist creating lush, modern arrangements with locally sourced and seasonal flowers whenever possible. Their signature style leans romantic and textural — think garden roses, ranunculus, and eucalyptus — and they're popular for weddings and events in the Liberty Village gallery spaces. Walk-in bouquets are available daily.
proTip: Subscribe to their weekly flower delivery for your home — it's cheaper per arrangement than buying individual bouquets and you'll always have fresh flowers.

name: Mopify
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON M6K
description: Mopify is a Toronto-based house cleaning service that's popular with Liberty Village condo dwellers for its easy online booking and consistent quality. Their vetted cleaners handle everything from regular weekly tidying to deep cleans and move-in/move-out services. Pricing is transparent and based on condo size, with no hidden fees.
proTip: Book a recurring biweekly clean and you'll get priority scheduling — one-off bookings often get bumped to less convenient time slots during busy seasons.

name: RBC Royal Bank
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: The RBC branch in Liberty Village provides full personal and small business banking services. Their advisors handle mortgage applications, investment accounts, and everyday banking needs. The branch is modern and well-staffed, though like any bank, complex transactions require an appointment.
proTip: Book mortgage appointments for Tuesday or Wednesday mornings — advisors are less rushed and can spend more time finding you the best rate.

name: Lavish Hair Studio
address: 87 Wade Ave, Toronto, ON M6H 1P8
description: Lavish Hair Studio sits on the edge of Liberty Village and offers a full range of hair services from colour and highlights to extensions and keratin treatments. The stylists specialize in balayage and lived-in colour techniques that look natural and grow out gracefully. The salon has a warm, personal atmosphere that makes you feel like a regular from the first visit.
proTip: Ask for a consultation before booking your first colour appointment — the stylists prefer to see your hair in person to give an accurate quote and timeline.

name: BenchMark Optometry
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Unit 101, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: BenchMark Optometry combines thorough eye health assessments with a curated frame shop stocking independent eyewear brands. The optometrists invest time in explaining your eye health and use retinal imaging technology for a complete picture. Their frame selection is trendy but functional, and the staff help you find styles that actually suit your face.
proTip: If your insurance covers $200+ for frames, tell them your budget upfront — they'll steer you to brands where you maximize coverage without paying out of pocket.

name: Precision Athletics
address: 38 Hanna Ave, Unit 12, Toronto, ON M6K 1X3
description: Precision Athletics is a private training studio offering one-on-one and small group personal training sessions. The coaches develop individualized programs based on thorough assessments and focus on progressive overload and measurable results. The studio is well-equipped with quality strength training equipment and none of the distractions of a commercial gym.
proTip: Commit to at least 8 sessions to see real results — the first 2-3 are assessment and baseline, and the real programming doesn't kick in until after that.

name: Liberty Village Real Estate Team
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 500, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: This boutique real estate team specializes exclusively in Liberty Village condos and has intimate knowledge of every building, floor plan, and maintenance fee in the neighbourhood. Whether you're buying your first condo or selling to upgrade, they know the micro-market trends that generalist agents miss. Their free home evaluations are no-pressure and genuinely informative.
proTip: Ask them which buildings have upcoming special assessments — this insider knowledge can save you tens of thousands or help you negotiate a better price.

name: Sweet Pete's Bike Shop
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: Sweet Pete's is a full-service bike shop offering new and used bike sales, expert repairs, and seasonal tune-ups. The mechanics are knowledgeable and honest about what your bike actually needs versus what's optional. They also stock a solid range of accessories, locks, and urban cycling gear suited to condo living.
proTip: Bring your bike in for a spring tune-up in March before the April rush — by May the wait time for service can stretch to over a week.

name: Pure Barre Liberty Village
address: 171 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P6
description: Pure Barre offers low-impact, high-intensity barre classes that combine ballet-inspired movements with strength training and stretching. Classes are 50 minutes of isometric holds, small-range movements, and targeted muscle work that builds lean strength. The studio has a supportive community and modifications are always available for beginners.
proTip: Take the foundations class first even if you're fit — barre technique is specific and learning the form early will make every subsequent class more effective.

name: Blueprint Accounting
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 303, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: Blueprint Accounting serves Liberty Village's freelancers, small businesses, and incorporated professionals with year-round tax planning and bookkeeping services. They specialize in the tech startup and creative professional demographics that dominate the neighbourhood. Their cloud-based approach means most work happens remotely with quarterly check-ins.
proTip: Don't wait until March to reach out for tax season — book your tax prep consultation in January and you'll get their full attention instead of being squeezed in.

name: Rexall Pharmacy
address: 1 East Liberty St, Toronto, ON M6K 3P9
description: Rexall provides a second pharmacy option in Liberty Village, convenient for residents on the west side of the neighbourhood. The pharmacy team is friendly and handles prescription transfers smoothly. They also carry a standard selection of health and beauty products, though the store footprint is more compact than the Shoppers location.
proTip: Transfer your prescription here from Shoppers if the wait times there frustrate you — Rexall is consistently less busy and fills prescriptions faster.

name: Liberty Village Child Care Centre
address: 50 Western Battery Rd, Toronto, ON M6K 3S1
description: Liberty Village Child Care Centre provides licensed daycare for infants through preschool age in a purpose-built facility. The curriculum is play-based with structured learning activities, outdoor time, and a focus on social-emotional development. In a neighbourhood where young families are increasingly common, the waitlist reflects the demand for quality childcare.
proTip: Get on the waitlist the moment you find out you're expecting — seriously, the wait can be 12-18 months and planning early is the only way to secure a spot.

name: Feast Catering Co.
address: 38 Hanna Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 1X3
description: Feast Catering operates out of a commercial kitchen in the Hanna Ave warehouse district and caters events throughout Liberty Village and beyond. They specialize in corporate catering for the neighbourhood's many tech offices and creative agencies, with menus that go well beyond the usual sandwich platter. Custom menus are their strength.
proTip: For office lunches, order by 10am the day before and ask about their weekly rotating menu — it keeps your team fed without menu fatigue.

name: Artscape Youngplace
address: 180 Shaw St, Toronto, ON M6J 2W5
description: Artscape Youngplace is a stunning multi-purpose arts facility in a converted school building on the border of Liberty Village. The gallery spaces and performance hall host everything from art exhibitions and product launches to weddings and corporate events. The heritage architecture provides a dramatic backdrop that requires minimal additional decor.
proTip: Book the main gallery for winter events — the massive windows catch the afternoon light beautifully, and you'll save on lighting costs compared to an evening booking.

name: Miku Toronto
address: 161 Bay St, Toronto, ON M5J 2S1
description: While technically just outside Liberty Village on the waterfront, Miku is the closest premium sushi experience and worth the short trip. Their aburi (flame-seared) sushi is a Vancouver import that's become a Toronto favourite, and the waterfront location offers stunning views. It's a splurge-worthy destination for special occasions.
proTip: Order the Aburi Salmon Oshi — it's the dish that made Miku famous and the one thing every first-timer should try before exploring the rest of the menu.

name: Liberty Village Music School
address: 99 Atlantic Ave, Suite 102, Toronto, ON M6K 3J8
description: Liberty Village Music School offers private lessons in guitar, piano, drums, voice, and more for kids and adults at all levels. The instructors are working musicians who bring real-world experience to their teaching. The studio rooms are soundproofed and the scheduling is flexible enough to work around shift work and irregular hours.
proTip: Book a trial lesson before committing to a package — instructor fit is everything in music education and you want someone whose teaching style clicks.

name: Modern Liberty Village Townhouse
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A beautifully designed two-storey townhouse in the heart of Liberty Village with a fully equipped kitchen, open-concept living, private rooftop patio, and dedicated workspace. Steps from the best restaurants, coffee shops, and the King streetcar. Ideal for couples, families, or professionals in town for work.
proTip: The rooftop patio is perfect for morning coffee with a great view of the neighborhood. The host lives in LV and has excellent restaurant recommendations — just ask.

name: Liberty Village Loft with Free Parking
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A bright open-concept loft with one free parking spot included — a rare perk in Liberty Village. Industrial-style space with exposed brick, high ceilings, and a comfortable queen bed. Located on a quiet street within a short walk of East Liberty restaurants and the 504 streetcar.
proTip: The free parking spot is a huge deal in Liberty Village — street parking is tough, especially on TFC game days.

name: Chic 1BR Loft Townhouse
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A stylish one-bedroom loft townhouse with soaring ceilings and a mezzanine sleeping area. Fully stocked modern kitchen and a cozy sectional perfect for unwinding after exploring Toronto. Walking distance to Liberty Village's best brunch spots and nightlife.
proTip: The mezzanine layout makes this feel much larger than a typical one-bedroom. Great for couples.

name: Liberty Village Suite — Roof Patio & Parking
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A well-located suite near BMO Field with a shared rooftop patio and parking included. Great for sports fans visiting for TFC or Argos games, or anyone wanting easy access to Exhibition Place events. Clean, modern, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
proTip: If you're here for a TFC game, you can walk to BMO Field in under 10 minutes. Skip the game-day parking nightmare.

name: Spacious Private Townhouse Loft
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A spacious multi-level townhouse loft with plenty of room to spread out. Two bedrooms and a separate living area make this a solid pick for small groups or families. Walking distance to grocery stores, cafes, and the streetcar line.
proTip: Good option if you're visiting with kids — more space than a typical condo rental and the neighbourhood is very walkable.

name: Prime Location Stylish LV Townhouse
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A thoughtfully decorated townhouse in a prime Liberty Village location. Clean, well-maintained, and close to all the action on East Liberty Street. The host provides a local guidebook with restaurant and coffee shop recommendations.
proTip: Ask the host for their local guidebook — it has genuinely good recommendations that you won't find on Google.

name: Downtown Toronto Condo — Liberty Village
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A compact but comfortable condo in a modern Liberty Village building with gym and rooftop terrace amenities. Simple, clean, and an affordable base for exploring Toronto's west end. Close to the King streetcar for quick trips downtown.
proTip: Budget-friendly option that works well for solo travellers. The building gym saves you from needing a day pass elsewhere.

name: Apartment in Liberty Village
address: Liberty Village, Toronto, ON
description: A straightforward apartment rental in the Liberty Village neighbourhood. No frills, but everything is clean and functional. Good transit access via the nearby King streetcar and a short walk to local restaurants and shops.
proTip: Solid no-fuss option if you just need a clean place to sleep and plan to spend most of your time out exploring.
